title: AlmaLinux OS 9 must have the gnutls-utils package installed.
check_content:
Verify that AlmaLinux OS 9 has the gnutls-utils package installed with the following command:

$ dnf list --installed gnutls-utils

Installed Packages
gnutls-utils.x86_64            3.7.6-23.el9_2.tuxcare.3                     @@commandline

If the "gnutls-utils" package is not installed, this is a finding.
fixtext:
The gnutls-utils package can be installed with the following command:
 
$ dnf install gnutls-utils
VulnDiscussion: GnuTLS is a secure communications library implementing the SSL, TLS, and DTLS protocols and technologies around them. It provides a simple C language application programming interface (API) to access the secure communications protocols as well as APIs to parse and write X.509, PKCS #12, OpenPGP, and other required structures. This package contains command line TLS client and server and certificate manipulation tools.
